name: ValueQuality
description: Composite Value + Quality strategy. Ranks stocks by P/B (value, lower is better) and ROE (quality, higher is better). Requires CVM fundamentals data (DFP/ITR) to be loaded in the DB.

signal.expr:
nan_add(
  pb_weight
  * (1.0 - rank(where(f_pb_ratio_dyn,
                      (f_pb_ratio_dyn <= max_pb) & (f_pb_ratio_dyn > 0)))),
  (1.0 - pb_weight)
  * rank(f_net_income_ttm / where(f_equity, f_equity > 0))
)
